mechanism: constitutive Ca2+ entry through ORAI1 boosts SK3 K+ currents in HEK293 and LNCaP cells, independently of STIM1; an intact ORAI1 pore and both termini are required, and the pore mutant E106Q fails
sentence: We show in the current study, via heterologous protein expression, that Orai1 can enhance SK3 K+ currents, in addition to constitutively bound calmodulin (CaM).
justification: Calcium entering through ORAI1 drives a potassium channel that in turn sustains the driving force for more entry: a feedback loop on the SOCE side, and the one that supports proliferation in breast, colon and prostate cancer cells.

mechanism: co-immunoprecipitation and pixel-by-pixel co-localization of SK3 and ORAI1 at discrete plasma-membrane spots, in wild-type and in STIM1/ORAI1 double-knockout HEK293 cells
sentence: In line with the co-localization of SK3 and Orai1, we discovered co-immunoprecipitation of SK3 and Orai1 in wild-type HEK 293 and HEK 293 STIM1/Orai1 DKO cells
justification: The physical complex behind the ORAI1-SK3 feedback, and the reason it survives the loss of STIM1.

mechanism: STIM2 recruits ORAI1/STIM1 to ER-PM junctions on store depletion, which promotes assembly of the channel with AKAP79; STIM2 knockdown barely changes clustering or [Ca2+]i but attenuates the ORAI1-AKAP79 assembly
sentence: We report that STIM2 recruitment of Orai1/STIM1 to ER-PM junctions in response to depletion of ER-Ca2+ promotes assembly of the channel with AKAP79 to form a signaling complex that couples Orai1 channel function to the activation of NFAT1.
justification: The scaffold that turns calcium entry into a transcriptional decision: without AKAP79 the same calcium does not reach NFAT.

mechanism: the ORAI1/STIM1/AKAP79 signalling complex couples channel function to NFAT1 activation; STIM2 knockdown attenuates NFAT1 activation without changing global [Ca2+]i
sentence: We report that STIM2 recruitment of Orai1/STIM1 to ER-PM junctions in response to depletion of ER-Ca2+ promotes assembly of the channel with AKAP79 to form a signaling complex that couples Orai1 channel function to the activation of NFAT1.
justification: The classical SOCE output, shown here to depend on where the channel sits rather than on how much calcium enters.
